description_en: Initiate an outbound call based on the instance ID, agent account name, hotline outbound caller number, and callee number
description_zh: 根据实例ID、坐席账号名称、热线外呼主叫号码、被叫号码发起外呼
kebab_example: aliyun aiccs start-call --instance-id ccc_xp_pre-cn-000 --account-name username@example.com --caller 9060000 --callee 13609870000 --api-version 2019-10-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: StartCall

parameters.help_en: Unique customer request ID. Used for idempotency validation. You can generate it using a UUID
parameters.help_zh: 客户请求唯一ID。用于幂等校验，可以用UUID生成
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS) instance ID.  
You can obtain it from Instance Management in the left-side navigation pane of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID。 您可以在智能联络中心控制台 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: Agent account name, which is the phone number or mailbox entered during account registration. It is unique within the instance
parameters.help_zh: 坐席账号名称，即账号注册时填写的手机或邮箱。实例内唯一。
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en: Caller number for the hotline outbound call
parameters.name: caller

parameters.help_en: Callee number for the hotline outbound call
parameters.name: callee

Code.description_en: Status code. A return value of "Success" indicates that the request succeeded
Code.description_zh: 状态码。返回Success表示请求成功

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the API call succeeded.
true: Succeeded.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
接口调用是否成功。
true：成功。
false：失败
